summary_ja: ファースト・トゥ・デフォルト型クレジット・デリバティブでプロテクションを提供する場合、対象エクスポージャーのリスク・ウェイトを合計（上限千二百五十パーセント）して与信相当額に乗じる。
summary_en: Selling first-to-default protection: risk weights of the basket names are summed (capped at 1,250%) and applied to the credit equivalent amount.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach provides protection through a first-to-default credit derivative, it shall calculate credit risk-weighted assets by summing the risk weights of the multiple exposures that may be covered by the protection, up to a maximum of 1,250%, and multiplying the credit equivalent amount of that credit derivative by that risk weight.
